blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Another wave of pump price rollbacks is expected to hit this week, easing motorists’ burden brought about by the rise in fuel prices due mainly to the Middle East conflict. This week, at least one of the major oil firms will be implementing a drop of up to P5.80 per liter. On Monday, Seaoil said in a statement that diesel prices would decline by P3.80 per liter starting Tuesday.
